flash-next-strata-solo.note: Renamed and promoted on 2026-10-15: it is a resident now, so local-ai.profile says what every other coding resident says (primary) instead of trial. That label is the one byte of this service the rename changed; the launch arguments, mounts, GPUs and model alias did not move. Re-pinned on 2026-10-16 for a change that is not the rename: the encoder image, the fifth GPU the shared vision card brings, and the two variables that place the encoder on it. Both digests move together and only that; the text placement inside the four cards is byte-for-byte what it was, which is what the pair of them now pins. Re-pinned on 2026-10-17 for two variables this container is now told through and nothing else moved: --sampling, whose default now states off, and STRATA_ALLOWED_HOSTS, which took the host names the server answers out of a hand edit inside the workspace and into source.

flash-next-strata-solo-thinking.note: Never renamed, and pinned anyway: this fixture holds the launch digest of every selectable configuration, and this one is the greedy configuration one variable away. The two digests differ from flash-next-strata-solo by exactly the SAMPLING value -- AVariantIsOneLineApartFromItsOriginal is what proves that and what refuses the pair the moment they diverge in anything else.
